mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>tan</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><mn>10</mn><mn>0.8</mn></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{10}{0.8}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>, run over rise. Tangent is rise over run: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>tan</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><mn>0.8</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{0.8}{10}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.
That is the angle in degrees. Set the calculator to radian mode.

items.q: Which ramp makes the largest angle with the ground, and what is that angle to three decimal places?

The sloped surface of ramp M is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mn>145.44</mn></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{145.44}</annotation></semantics></math> meters long. Find the ramp's angle with <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\theta</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mfrac><mtext>rise</mtext><mtext>surface length</mtext></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{\text{rise}}{\text{surface length}}</annotation></semantics></math>, correct to three decimal places.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1.2</mn><msqrt><mn>145.44</mn></msqrt></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1.2}{\sqrt{145.44}}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> for ramp K's numbers; use ramp M's rise, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1.2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.2</annotation></semantics></math>.
That is the angle in degrees; set the calculator to radian mode.

items.q: A new ramp has the same run as ramp L, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">10</annotation></semantics></math> meters, and must make an angle of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>0.07</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.07</annotation></semantics></math> radians with the ground. What rise does it need, correct to three decimal places?

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>10</mn><msup><mi>tan</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.07</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">10\tan^{-1}(0.07)</annotation></semantics></math>. The angle is given, so apply <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan</annotation></semantics></math> to it: rise <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mi>tan</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.07</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 10\tan(0.07)</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^{-1}\left(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\frac{4\pi}{3} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, but <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{4\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math> is outside <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{5\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math> names the same direction as <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\frac{\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>, but the range of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^{-1}</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\left(-\frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\frac{1}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>. The value <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math> belongs to <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>tan</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan^{-1}(-1)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan\frac{3\pi}{4} = -1</annotation></semantics></math>, but <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{3\pi}{4}</annotation></semantics></math> is outside <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>7</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{7\pi}{4}</annotation></semantics></math> points the same way as <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\frac{\pi}{4}</annotation></semantics></math>, but it is outside the range of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>tan</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan^{-1}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: What is the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^{-1}\left(\sin\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>?

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) = 2\sin x + 1</annotation></semantics></math> with domain <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math> is invertible. Find <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{-1}(x)</annotation></semantics></math> for <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-1 \le x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: Undo the <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+1</annotation></semantics></math> by subtracting <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{x - 1}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

The steps are undone in the wrong order. <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin</annotation></semantics></math> was applied first, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^{-1}</annotation></semantics></math> is applied last.

Cosecant is its reciprocal: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mfrac><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{2}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cot</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cot\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\cos}{\sin}</annotation></semantics></math>. Cosecant is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\sin}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Using the table, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cot</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cot\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin}{\cos}</annotation></semantics></math>, the tangent. Cotangent is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\cos}{\sin}</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>π</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\cos(\pi/6)}</annotation></semantics></math>, the secant. Cotangent is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\cos}{\sin}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Using the table, which value is undefined?

Using the table, how do the values of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\csc\theta</annotation></semantics></math> change as <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta</annotation></semantics></math> goes from <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>?

Rewrite <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos x \csc x</annotation></semantics></math> as a single trigonometric function of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}</annotation></semantics></math> is cotangent; tangent is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\csc x = \frac{1}{\sin x}</annotation></semantics></math>, so the product is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}</annotation></semantics></math>, not <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos x</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\csc x</annotation></semantics></math> are not reciprocals; <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\csc x</annotation></semantics></math> is the reciprocal of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin x</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Rewrite <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan x \csc x</annotation></semantics></math> as a single trigonometric function of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: After the sines cancel, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math> is left, which is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sec x</annotation></semantics></math>, not <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos x</annotation></semantics></math>.

Write both in sines and cosines: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin x}{\cos x} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin x}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{1}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Which of these are locations of vertical asymptotes of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>csc</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = \csc x</annotation></semantics></math> on the open interval <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, 2\pi)</annotation></semantics></math>? Select every one.

What is the period of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>cot</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = \cot(2x)</annotation></semantics></math>?

Find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sec\frac{5\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: Cosine is negative in Quadrant II, so secant is negative there too.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\sin(5\pi/6)}</annotation></semantics></math> with the wrong sign; secant uses the cosine, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\frac{5\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>; take its reciprocal.

items.q: Which function has range <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-\infty, \infty)</annotation></semantics></math>?

As <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math> increases from <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>, predict how each quantity changes.

The graph shows <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) = 1 - 2\sin^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>. Which function has the same graph?
For the function in the graph, what is the period of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f</annotation></semantics></math>?

For the function in the graph, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - 2\cdot\frac{1}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>: the sine was not squared. <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^2\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{4}</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - \sin^2\frac{\pi}{6}</annotation></semantics></math>; the <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2</annotation></semantics></math> in front multiplies <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: For the function in the graph, find every solution of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) = 0</annotation></semantics></math> on <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0, 2\pi)</annotation></semantics></math>.

Rewrite <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) = 1 - 2\sin^2 x</annotation></semantics></math> using <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos x</annotation></semantics></math> only.

mistakes.why: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^2 x</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - \cos^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>, not <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>; distribute the <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-2</annotation></semantics></math> over <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - \cos^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>.

The cosine is squared: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\cos^2 x - 1</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin^2 x = 1 - \cos^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>; the square is on the cosine alone, not on <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - \cos x</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Using the table, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin(\alpha + \beta)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\alpha + \sin\beta</annotation></semantics></math>. The sine of a sum is not the sum of the sines; use <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta</annotation></semantics></math>, which is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>β</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos(\alpha - \beta)</annotation></semantics></math>.

The sine sum identity adds the two products: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>15</mn><mn>65</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>48</mn><mn>65</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{15}{65} + \frac{48}{65}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Using the table, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos(\alpha + \beta)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: The cosine of a sum subtracts: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\alpha + \cos\beta</annotation></semantics></math>. Use the sum identity instead.

items.q: Using the table, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>α</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin(2\alpha)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sin\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>. The double-angle identity is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>; sine values never exceed <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin\alpha\cos\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>; multiply by <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Using the table, find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>β</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos(2\beta)</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\cos\beta</annotation></semantics></math>; use <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos^2\beta - \sin^2\beta</annotation></semantics></math>.

The identity is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos^2\beta - \sin^2\beta</annotation></semantics></math>, cosine first: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>25</mn><mn>169</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>144</mn><mn>169</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{25}{169} - \frac{144}{169}</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Rewrite <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin(2x)}{2\cos^2 x}</annotation></semantics></math> as a single trigonometric function of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: The <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2</annotation></semantics></math> in <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin(2x)</annotation></semantics></math> is part of the angle, not a factor to cancel with the <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2</annotation></semantics></math> below. Expand <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin(2x) = 2\sin x\cos x</annotation></semantics></math> first.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{2\sin x\cos x}{2\cos^2 x}</annotation></semantics></math> cancels one cosine, leaving <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

The sine is on top, so the quotient is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi>tan</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \tan x</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: Rewrite <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>tan</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1 + \tan^2 x)\cos x</annotation></semantics></math> as a single trigonometric function of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>tan</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>sec</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 + \tan^2 x = \sec^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>, and multiplying by <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos x</annotation></semantics></math> cancels one factor: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sec x</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>tan</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 + \tan^2 x</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>sec</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sec^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>, not <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>; the result is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{\cos x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

Use <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>12</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\pi}{12} = \frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{4}</annotation></semantics></math> to find the exact value of <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>12</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\frac{\pi}{12}</annotation></semantics></math>.

mistakes.why: The cosine difference identity adds the products: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos a\cos b + \sin a\sin b</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos\frac{\pi}{3} - \cos\frac{\pi}{4}</annotation></semantics></math>. The cosine of a difference is not the difference of the cosines.
